description:
Save recipes from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and the web.

Paste a link and MainCourse turns it into a clean, structured recipe: ingredients, steps, prep time, servings. Browse them anytime, even offline.

A shopping list that starts with your recipes
Review the ingredients you need, adjust quantities for your servings, and add them to your shopping list. Items are sorted into aisles, so you can tick them off as you shop.

Cook together
Share a cookbook with family or flatmates. Everyone can add recipes and use the shared shopping list.

Capture anything
Photograph a page from a cookbook or a handwritten note and it gets imported the same way.

Built for how you actually save recipes
– Import from TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube, and recipe websites
– Share sheet support: import from Safari or social apps without switching
– Offline access to your saved recipes
– Search by name or ingredient
– Scale ingredient quantities by changing the number of servings
– Adjust recipe details, edit ingredients, and add notes
– Keep the screen awake while following a recipe

New here? Try saving an example recipe with the guided introduction.

Free to start. Subscribe for unlimited imports.

whatsNew:
MainCourse now speaks German and Polish. The app follows your iPhone's language, and notifications arrive in your language too.

Your shopping list is now sorted into aisles, so you can shop one section at a time.

Plus improvements to recipe importing and reliability.
